title: Aviation Bridging Loans
summary: Silver Oak Capital's aviation bridging loans page (as surfaced only through search-engine summaries, never fetched directly) presents aircraft bridging loans as a well-established, short-term (0-24 months) and more expensive form of aircraft finance, used when a buyer needs fast funds for a time-limited opportunity such as an open-market aircraft sale, with a longer-term facility (up to 25 years) arranged afterwards. The firm states it has worked on a number of aircraft bridging loans over the years. Search results also surfaced related FAQ-style statements (LTV depends on borrower profile and aircraft; newer popular models may reach +75% LTV; bridging can refinance an existing aircraft purchase if the asset is strong and the borrower low-risk) and two non-bridging aviation case studies (Falcon 900: 70% LTV, 4.45% fixed, 72 months; G650: $40m, 80% LTV, 10 years). No aircraft bridging rates, fees, minimum loan size, calls to action, H1/meta text or process steps were revealed.
